sections.h2: The largest single import lines are polymers and their petrochemical inputs

chart.title: Polymers lead the largest single chemical import lines, led by LDPE and LLDPE
chart.sub: Largest single-line chemical imports, FY2025-26, US$ million.
chart.source: DGCI&S TradeStat, FY2025-26; this blog's corrected top-15 table.

sections.means: Plastics are where India's chemical trade runs a deficit, while chemicals as a whole are roughly in balance.
sections.todo: Judge the new scheme by whether its shared utilities reach these polymer and intermediate lines, not by its park count.

sections.h2: Dahej holds about 93% of the units across India's three petrochemical regions

chart.title: Dahej has 2,079 of 2,246 units; the other two regions have 167 together
chart.sub: Units in the three PCPIR regions, July 2026.
chart.source: Rajya Sabha reply, 28 Jul 2026; the other-region value is this blog's subtraction.

sections.means: The 2007 regions mostly did not fill, with Dahej, beside an existing chemical belt, carrying almost all the units.
sections.todo: Before committing new parks, the government should report unit and investment counts by region, so the gap between plan and outcome is visible.

sections.h2: Only Rs 180 crore of the bulk-drug parks' Rs 3,000 crore had been released

chart.title: Released funds were 6% of the outlay after nearly six years

chart.source: Government figures as reported in this blog's piece; December 2025 release status.

sections.means: The scheme that BHAVYA Rasayan copies spent only a small share of its money in its first five years.
